title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to Eurydike, the roofless hall of the Kothringi knights north of Gideon, to open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone; the knights once guarded the kings' road to the Root, the place under the sea where every Hist's roots meet and the Eye of Argonia lies. The knights' dead walk the barracks wing, and the Unbound got there before me. I'm to search the Unbound's packs by their fire on the way to the tomb. I may fight, slip past, or turn the dead with Restoration. All of it is a trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, which lies at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea; the order wants it found before the Unbound reach it.
objectives: Search the Unbound's packs in Eurydike's barracks wing. (marker: Unbound Pack)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike; the Unbound are there ahead of me. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Go to Eurydike and search the Unbound's packs on the way to the tomb.
plan.ways: Fight the dead and the Unbound, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka and her order. We want the Eye of Argonia, the old kings jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root under the sea, before the Unbound reach it. The knight-captain buried at Eurydike has what marks the way. The Unbound are already here digging.
Search the Unbound packs in the barracks wing at Eurydike, then open the knight-captain tomb with the keystone.
I can fight the dead, slip past quietly (my preferred way), or turn the dead with Restoration.
I do not fully understand the Root or how Nesh-Deeka knows things. I could learn more from the packs, the tomb and people I meet.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: In the Unbound's packs were bottles of the grey paste they call "the seal". It is a paralysis poison: it numbs a tree's scar shut. The Unbound drain a tree and then poison it. If they wanted the trees dead they could kill them, so why seal a tree they drain? I'm to open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone. It is all on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea.
objectives: Open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone and search it. (marker: Door to Knight-Captain's Tomb, Knight-Captain's Tomb Chest)

plan.going: The seal is a paralysis poison. I do not know why the Unbound seal trees they drain: that question is open. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Open the tomb with the keystone and search the knight-captain's chest.
plan.ways: The keystone is the door's key; the dead and the Unbound may still be about.
terms: paralysis poison (the seal): the item's name and journal 20

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. The Unbound drain trees and then seal them with a grey paralysis poison, the seal, which I found in their pack. We want the Eye of Argonia at the Root before them.
Open the knight-captain tomb door here at Eurydike with the keystone and search the chest inside.
Use the keystone on the door; deal with the Restless Knight and Unbound Digger by sneaking, fighting or turning the dead.
I do not understand why the Unbound seal a tree they drain. I might learn from Nesh-Deeka or the tomb.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: In the knight-captain's tomb lay a bronze disc stamped with a mine's mark, a pick crossed with a tower. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. It is all on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea.
objectives: Bring the bronze disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The disc bears a mine's mark; I do not know which mine. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. The keystone opened the knight-captain tomb and I took a bronze disc stamped with a mine mark, a pick crossed with a tower. It is a step on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, which the Unbound also want.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: Nesh-Deeka knew the mark: Vicrium, an old mine in the clay country behind Seafalls, in the east. She already knew the Unbound had been at Eurydike. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and would not answer why they seal the trees. She paid me 100 gold. The question stays with me. It is all on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea.

plan.going: The disc points to Vicrium. Why the Unbound seal the trees is still open; Nesh-Deeka knows where they go and will not say how. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: MN10 starts; its first entry marks Vicrium.
terms: Vicrium: Nesh-Deeka: an old mine behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei

answers: The quest is done. I work for Nesh-Deeka. The disc bears the mark of Vicrium, an old ochre and alum mine in the clay country behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei, in the east. The knights kept a strongbox there. It is the next step toward the Eye of Argonia at the Root. The Unbound are ahead of us.
No new objective is set. Likely I go to Vicrium near Seafalls and find the strongbox.
I can travel east to Seafalls and Vicrium, or ask Nesh-Deeka more first.
I still do not know how Nesh-Deeka knows things ("we listen"), why the Unbound seal the trees they drain, or what the Eye does exactly. I have not found how to learn these yet.
